newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Midcontinent diesel, jet prices drift higher.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Midcontinent diesel, jet prices drift higher.

text.p: U.S. Midcontinent diesel and jet fuel prices drifted higher Friday as NYMEX heating oil futures rebounded and differentials firmed in the spot markets, traders said.
Jet/kero basis also continued its ascent in Group Three, where strong demand has pushed differentials higher through the week in the Midwest markets, traders said.
As discussion wound down for the week, gasoline differentials were largely unchanged in the Group Three market but saw some newfound strength in Chicago, traders said.
Low sulphur diesel bids firmed to 2.50 cents a gallon over NYMEX March heating oil in Group Three and were steady at 2.75 cents over the print in Chicago for prompt barrels, traders said.
High sulphur diesel was talked 0.50 cent a gallon over the print in Group Three and 1.0 cent over the print in Chicago.
Unleaded gasoline was bid 1.50 cent a gallon over NYMEX March unleaded in Group Three and firmed to 1.75 cents under the print in Chicago for prompt barrels.
Jet/kero climbed to bids 5.75 cents over the print in Group Three and holding at a lofty 4.25 cents over in Chicago, traders said.
